name: Call of Air
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, adventurer?
narrative.objectives: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
